title: Open issue with no pull request
body: Closed since the first import. A card tracks it, so it must be reconciled to Done — not ignored the way an untracked closed issue is.

title: Open issue whose pull request is ready
body: Paired with PR 201 by its branch, so it lands in In Review.

title: Open issue whose pull request is still a draft
body: Paired with PR 202, which is a draft, so it lands in In Progress.

title: Closed issue that no card tracks
body: Must NOT be imported: closed history is not a backlog, and importing it would make Done a graveyard.
